description: Eight independently authored exact-twin scenario clusters and twelve partitioned unrelated controls for an opened-development feasibility pilot. Four scenarios calibrate one global dose per method and four are an opened cross-encoding check on held-out templated scenario text. Unrelated controls are disjoint across nuisance fitting, calibration, and pilot evaluation. This prompt-conditioned study is not an out-of-distribution scenario-transfer test, publication validation, or sealed test set.
construction_instruction: State the selected action in exactly one plain-English sentence. Do not use an answer label, index, code, or JSON key.
